mapper.insert: INSERT INTO local_event_saves (event_id, user_id, saved_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{userId}, #{savedAt}) ON CONFLICT (event_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM local_event_saves WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO local_event_reminders (event_id, user_id, kind, sent_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{userId}, #{kind}, #{sentAt}) ON CONFLICT (event_id, user_id, kind) DO NOTHING
